uploads/science/Scipad/Year 10 Book 2/An.searchText: FORCES AND MOTION Friction Friction is a force that occurs when two materials rub together. Friction always acts to oppose (prevent or stop) the movement of an object. Drag is another name for the friction that occurs when an object moves through a fluid, such as air or water.
